head: 2db0edc9edb315026eee4b6edd43b420a569c37d
scope: Read-only integrated review of 14 backend source/test paths. No new test suite, benchmark, live call, DB access, Git mutation or repository edit was performed for this review.

authorship_disclosure.separate_cost_review: source_read_review independently read cost helper/default wiring and reported no blocker.

checks.collector_wiring: Assignment/cost/hold builders execute once per collect inside source_order_indexes through existing joined prepare_in_thread. Optional indexes are passed only at intended collector call sites; existing recorded-fee lookup remains.
checks.eager_failures: Exact-type scalar/container guards avoid custom method execution; malformed/unusual shapes select legacy fallback. Price/currency/options, assignment status/driver proof and hold Decimal/saved/direct/pooled short circuits remain at their original use points.
checks.attempt_and_CAS_scope: Data, output and indexes are newly owned by collect_sources. The store calls collect within its operation for each CAS attempt; there is no shared cache or final-cost/financial-decision cache.
checks.issue_integrity: Issue buckets retain row references/order and full dictionary equality. Append/update wrappers maintain or invalidate buckets; date_gap_identity changes metadata only. Collector removes its private index before normal return. Other callers without the private index keep ordinary list behavior.
checks.reads_and_writes: No new DB read/query or financial write is introduced. Existing bank_identities await only receives a fixed stage context. Runtime/auth/store/CAS/caps/deadlines and persisted financial schema are unchanged.
checks.default_other_callers: Optional cost/assignment arguments default to None and retain legacy paths; original _driver_assignment and hold_prior_courier_event bodies remain unchanged.
checks.cancellation: Helper loops use existing calculation_checkpoint; prepare_in_thread joins cancelled workers. No new background task or scheduler; cancellation is not converted into a monetary decision.
checks.logging: Only fixed source_order_indexes/source_bank_catalog stage names are added. No IDs, amounts, exception text or dynamic payload logging added.
checks.CI_discovery: All five changed/new test paths retain test_operational_balance prefix consumed by existing Operational glob.

resolved_finding.issue: Type membership could call hostile metaclass __eq__ during eager construction.
resolved_finding.resolution: Assignment/hold helpers now use type identity comparisons, with adversarial regression cases. Final hashes recorded.

peers.exit_provenance: release_gate_audit team message; JUnit parsed independently here.

root_combined.provenance: Root team message received during report preparation, not executed by reviewer

residual_limitations: Within one attempt, source rows/state must remain unchanged, as provided by the current collector/store scope; these are not persistent general-purpose caches.
Unusual input retains legacy scans and may receive less performance benefit.
Synthetic/local results do not prove live acceptance or attribute the production delay to a particular item shape. Exact CI, publication and a visible successful refresh remain root release gates.
